negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, smooth CGI plastic, digital 3D render, Pixar style, Disney style, photorealistic human skin, young girl, modern plastic packaging, neon lighting, deformed hands
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion puppet materials (matte polymer clay skin with delicate hand-sculpted smile lines, real knitted wool vest texture, fine mohair hair) — AI often renders generic 3D CGI or smooth plastic
gentle caricatured grandmotherly expression with elongated neck, smiling almond eyes, and curved nose — AI tends to normalize into standard anime or photorealistic human face
intricate miniature props (crinkled kraft paper bag, rustic wooden counter with chipped paint, miniature bread plate) — AI often hallucinates modern plastic items
warm, wholesome 3400K natural interior lighting with soft cinematic bokeh — AI often introduces harsh digital HDR or oversaturated artificial colors
